```plato

    // True when the position falls inside the band, and so may be non-zero.
    IsInBand(self: BandedMatrix, row: Integer, column: Integer): Boolean
        => column - row >= -self.LowerBandwidth
        && column - row <= self.UpperBandwidth;
```
